title: Residency transition sprint hypotheses and risk gambit
content:
Purpose:
This is a working sprint doc capturing a compact set of hypotheses, risks, and quick experiments for a residency-transition pilot (customer pilots that change pin/region anchors). Goal: surface brittle edge cases before a broader rollout and create repeatable operator actions for safe roll-forward/rollback.

Scope:
- Customer cohort: 6 pilot tenants across EU / US / APAC (mixed Dedicated + Private).
- Focus: region-anchor changes (move tenant anchor from eu-west to eu-north), operator-visible evidence packaging, and minimal customer-impact fallback.
- Out of scope for this sprint: legal contract amendments, billing proration (will be tracked separately).

Sprint hypotheses (ranked):
1) If we limit simultaneous anchor moves to <= 2 tenants per control-plane shard, operator errors will drop by ~60% (test by staged schedule).
2) Automated preflight evidence checks (KMS location, storage bucket region, connector whitelist) will catch >85% of failures that would otherwise require manual rollback.
3) Adding an explicit telemetry tag "residency_transition=attempt" to all requests during the window will make post-mortem attribution 3x faster.
4) Customers with ephemeral sessions (>20% ephemeral) are more likely to observe session affinity glitches — we can detect this and auto-apply soft-pin for 2 hours.

Decision matrix (quick reference):
- Accept move automatically: preflight_pass == true AND no cross-region open sessions AND no flagged-subprocessors.
- Require operator approval: preflight_pass == true AND (open_sessions > 0 OR tenant_has_kms_mix).
- Block move: preflight_fail == true OR legal_flag == true.

Operator checklist (to be executed for each anchor change):
1) Run preflight (scripts/preflight-residency.sh) -> attach report to ticket.
2) Verify KMS key location and active primary key replica.
3) Confirm backup snapshot exists and test restore of metadata only (not full restore).
4) Announce maintenance-window to tenant contacts via template (see Communications snippets).
5) Execute staged move: control-plane migrate -> storage rebind -> edge-affinity reconcile -> final audit evidence capture.
6) Warm caches (edge + prefix cache) prior to cutover for pinned clients.
7) Run smoke tests across three regions (latency, token-serving, auth).
8) Monitor 30m after change, keep operator window open for 120m.

Telemetry signals (what success/fail looks like):
- residency_transition.attempt (counter)
- residency_transition.preflight_pass (gauge boolean)
- residency_transition.rollback_invoked (counter)
- session.affinity.mismatch.rate (p95 over 10m window)
- api.latency.99p.post_transition (compare vs baseline)
- error.code.RESIDENCY_PIN_MISMATCH (count and unique tenant ids)

Risk register (top items):
1) KMS key replica missing -> customer data becomes unreadable from target region (Mitigation: enforce replica check + operator manual key-sync path).
2) Edge cache stale leading to 401/403 for active sessions (Mitigation: soft-pin fallback for 2h + immediate cache purge endpoints).
3) Subprocessor mismatch (third-party connectors in old region) -> legal exposure (Mitigation: block and escalate to legal).
4) Billing/chargeback mismatch for reserved capacity -> customer billing disputes (Mitigation: pre-notify finance + temporary credit policy template).

Test matrix (minimal QA before pilot move):
- Unit: preflight script deterministic outputs (pass/fail) for 10 representative tenants.
- Integration: end-to-end move on staging with synthetic traffic (10k requests/min for 15m).
- Chaos: simulate control-plane gateway flakiness during storage rebind (observe fallback behavior).
- Regression: run customer SDK flows for session resumption and model inference through both old/new region endpoints.

Rollback plan (criteria + steps):
Criteria to rollback: any of the following within 30m of cutover: auth failures > 1% of baseline, session affinity mismatch spike > 5x baseline, or operator-observed corruption in audit evidence.
Rollback steps (fast):
- Trigger operator rollback playbook ID: ROLLBACK-RT-01
- Rebind storage pointers back to origin
- Restore control-plane pin metadata snapshot (metadata-only restore)
- Reapply edge-affinity and warm caches
- Notify tenant: immediate rollback notice + expected timeline

Communications snippets (short):
- Pre-move: "We will perform a scheduled regional anchor update for your tenant on <date>. Brief outage expected for session resumption; no data loss anticipated. Contact: <eng-runbook-email>."
- Post-rollback: "We rolled back the change due to observed session failures. We are investigating and will follow up within 4 hours."

Evidence packaging (what we keep for audit):
- preflight.json (full preflight output)
- operator-log-ids (list of control-plane ops log ids)
- storage-rebind-audit.txt (timestamped)
- kms-replica-check.txt
- customer-notice-template + sent timestamp

Open questions / notes-to-self:
- Do we want a hard SLA that prevents anchor moves during license/billing cycle boundary? (legal + finance ask)
- How to represent multi-cloud anchor (tenant uses resources in GCP + AWS) vs single-cloud assumption in preflight?
- Need a concise diagram of the binding order (control-plane -> storage -> edge) for on-call cards.
- Add a quick script to compute likely cache-warm time based on tenant 7-day qps percentile.

Triage playbook quick flows (short names):
- Flow A (soft-fail): preflight warns only -> operator approves -> soft-pin for 2h after move.
- Flow B (operator block): preflight fail non-critical -> require manual remediation steps -> re-run preflight.
- Flow C (hard-block): legal flag OR kms mismatch -> block and open legal/eng incident.

Immediate next steps (for this sprint):
- Build preflight parity check with KMS replica verification (owner: Aisha, JIRA-2011).
- Add "residency_transition=attempt" tag in control-plane request path (owner: Michael, JIRA-2012).
- Draft operator rollback runbook ROLLBACK-RT-01 and submit to SRE review (owner: Liam).
- Schedule tabletop with Legal + CS for the three pilot tenants (owner: Priya).

Attachments & references:
- Confluence: region-pin-guidelines (linked above)
- Staging runbook: staging/residency-move-checklist (internal)
- Slack thread: #private-deploys thread pinned in linked_artifacts

Notes: this doc is intentionally compact and experimental — use it as the sprint living doc and update with real failure stories. Save a copy as final-runbook only when we have 3 successful pilot moves with no rollback.

Unresolved high-priority items to capture in retro:
- Time-to-detect for kms replica issues currently unknown (instrumentation gap).
- Operator cognitive load during multi-tenant shard moves (consider UI automation).

End of working doc.

(If you are editing: add tiny lines like "EDIT <date> — <summary>" so we can track key iterations in a single file.)
